title: Kippers with garlic mushrooms on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Kippers, butter, mushrooms, garlic, bread, thyme and lemon are all plain foods a grandparent would have kept.

supermarket.reason: Kippers, chestnut mushrooms and wholemeal bread are everyday items at Tesco and similar supermarkets.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a grill tray and a frying pan, and the technique is simple grilling and frying.

works.reason: Four kippers, 400g mushrooms and four slices of toast make a sensible breakfast for four, and the grill and frying times are right.

honest_times.reason: Fifteen minutes is enough to slice 400g of mushrooms and the garlic, pick the thyme and make toast, and the grill and fry times fit within ten minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Each name matches its id, and every listed ingredient and seasoning, including thyme, lemon and pepper, is used in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm kipper and mushroom breakfast suits early December, and 400g of mushrooms makes them a main part of the plate, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, homely British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Oily fish, plenty of mushrooms and wholemeal toast make a filling breakfast of real food.
